title: MetLife Certificate of Insurance — North Carolina Office of State Human Resources, Group Policy 165756-1-G, High Option (OSHR title: 'MetLife Dental High Option Certificate (12/2017)')
publisher: Metropolitan Life Insurance Company (MetLife); posted by North Carolina Office of State Human Resources
document_date_note: Face page: 'Certificate Date: January 1, 2018'. OSHR labels the file '(12/2017)' / 'dec-2017' — both recorded. Amended by the Certificate Riders effective January 1, 2024 (see Classic certificate JSON). Predates the 2026 plan year by eight years; no newer High certificate is posted as of 2026-10-03.

scope.geography: North Carolina (State of North Carolina employees); a UNC Chapel Hill edition is also posted (not opened)
scope.population: Employees under the NC OSHR group policy and their Dependents
scope.plan_type: Group dental insurance, In-Network (Preferred Dentist Program) and Out-of-Network

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF->text); two targeted passes; page numbers as reported from printed footers ('GCERT2000 ... <n>').
pages_note: TOC: SCHEDULE OF BENEFITS 41; DEFINITIONS 42; DENTAL INSURANCE 55; DESCRIPTION OF COVERED SERVICES 59; EXCLUSIONS 62; GENERAL PROVISIONS 72 — at least 72 printed pages. Reachable text ends at footer 'GCERT2000 50 e/dep' (dependent eligibility).
reuse_terms: not stated in reachable pages; insurer form GCERT2000; public posting by a North Carolina state agency.
access_limits: Text conversion ends at footer 'GCERT2000 50 e/dep'; DENTAL INSURANCE (p.55), DESCRIPTION OF COVERED SERVICES (p.59), EXCLUSIONS (p.62) and GENERAL PROVISIONS (p.72) NOT reached ('Alternate Benefits', 'Pre-Treatment Estimate', 'Deductible', 'Maximum Benefit', 'Waiting Period' subsections all reported NOT REACHED).

The deductible lines were returned as '...Type B; Type C' without the Classic certificate's 'excluding implants and implant services' tail; whether that tail exists in the High certificate was not re-verified (time box) — review_status needs_review.
